current_contract: Research reports are queued by application.cloud.feedback.queue_feedback -> ResearchJournal.enqueue_feedback in research_feedback_publications. Queue job ID and owning research run ID differ: use the persisted queue owner_run_id, never infer from job ID.

PaperFeedbackOutbox.queue binds actual historical run/checkpoint/process generation in paper_feedback_publications. pending/pending_feedback_publications omit acknowledged and conflicted rows. PaperFeedbackOutbox.publications includes metadata but does not validate stored report bytes/lineage; it is insufficient as the trusted UI source alone.

Persisted ACK enum is CLOUD_ACKNOWLEDGED. REMOTE_ACKED is not an existing DB value. Preserve CLOUD_ACKNOWLEDGED consistently with current Publication UI, or explicitly document a read-only display alias plus stored_state; never rewrite owner state. Include UNAVAILABLE as well as PENDING/LOCAL_STAGED/ACK/CONFLICT.

Current Publication component in ui/src/App.tsx57 already distinguishes states and hashes for intake. Existing ResearchQueue.evidence_view and PaperReadControlPort.view omit report publication history and invoke writer-opening factories; do not add a delivery read by borrowing those factories.
minimal_reader_design: Proposed ResearchPublicationReadPort(queue_path,research_path,namespace).history(job_id,limit=20,offset=0): trusted composition supplies exact existing paths. Protected RO queue snapshot validates schema/namespace/job and reads owner_run_id. RO research snapshot validates input_json/input_hash/namespace, exact owner run and immutable feedback lineage. Recheck immutable job-to-owner binding before return; no resolver/service_factory/ResearchJournal constructor or report generation.

Proposed PaperPublicationReadPort(process_path,namespace).history(run_id,limit=20,offset=0): exact schema/namespace/run binding plus bounded publication rows. Reuse/extract PaperFeedbackOutbox._check_record's pure checks: report/payload/aggregate hashes, strict publication validator, original binding/checkpoint hash and original generation/instance hash. Historical reports remain readable after a later valid process generation; do not require/allocate a current owner.

Reuse the new ResearchQueue.failed_alert_page protected reader pattern: local ancestor/reparse checks, regular single-link DB/present WAL-SHM, Windows-safe readonly URI, query_onlyON/trusted_schemaOFF/live-WAL awareness, read transaction, finite busy/query budget, SQL length limits and file-identity recheck. Build expected schema only in memory from owned migrations. Never execute migrations/PRAGMA journal_mode on disk or open any RW factory.

Share existing pure row/bundle validation with writer paths instead of a second financial/report engine. Research checks reuse validate_feedback_publication and enqueue_feedback's actual run/strategy/dataset/split hash binding; Paper checks reuse validate_paper_feedback_publication and _check_record. Include all durable states, filter exact run before ordered LIMIT/OFFSET and bounded COUNT, and never decode an unbounded payload.

Return only PageView-compatible metadata: operation_id,run_id,state,artifact_hash,feedback_hash,attempts,queued_at=created_at, plus Paper run_revision/process_generation. No report HTML/JSON/private raw IDs/path/alias/provider/account/credential text. Missing configured store/schema/hash/lineage=>sanitized unavailable, not empty success. Valid owner/no report=>AVAILABLE empty; no owner_run_id yet=>NOT_RUN/REPORT_NOT_READY, never generated report.
api_ui_wiring: Smallest strictly RO entry is two read-only leaf subroutes, proposed GET /api/v1/research/runs/{job_id}/publications and /api/v1/paper/runs/{run_id}/publications, with existing session checks and PageView envelope; OwnerControlServices delegates only to new RO ports. This avoids executing current detail-route RW factories solely for delivery. If embedding in existing detail instead, the new projection must still call only these path-bound readers and must not describe existing writer factories as read-only.

Use existing Publication renderer for each bounded history row in the selected Research/Paper detail with operation/hash and queued time. No publish/retry/ACK button or new command. Preserve read metadata time versus queued time; existing records have no ACK timestamp or transport provenance, so add neither fabricated ack_at nor real-cloud status.
